name: donestate
description: The Proof & State authorised execution plane for AI work, with independent OpsTruth verification handoff.

interface.longDescription: DoneState (proofandstate.com/donestate) is Proof & State's authorised execution plane for the AI Work Accountability category (aiworkaccountability.com). Describe a repository outcome, explicitly grant a bounded consequence envelope, and let DoneState run, validate and publish only within that authority. DoneState never proves its own completion; OpsTruth (opstruth.io) is the independent read-only verification plane.
defaultPrompt: Implement this issue and open a PR for independent verification.
Show me the state of my DoneState run.
